business.name: Northline Collision
business.crossStreet: Two lights east of 33rd, in the grey building behind the fuel station. Estimates park along the fence.
business.serviceArea: Portland, Vancouver, Gresham, Beaverton, Milwaukie and Hillsboro. We tow in from anywhere inside 20 miles on an insurance job.

services.name: Collision repair
services.line: Frame, panel and structural work on a laser measuring bench. We photograph every stage.

services.name: Paint & refinish
services.line: Computer-matched to your VIN, blended into the adjacent panels so the repair disappears.

services.name: Paintless dent removal
services.line: Door dings and hail. No filler, no paint, usually back the same afternoon.

services.name: Bumper repair
services.line: Cracks, scuffs and tab repairs. Cheaper than replacement on most plastic covers.

services.name: ADAS recalibration
services.line: Required after most windshield and bumper work. Done in-house, documented for your file.

services.name: Hail damage
services.line: We handle the whole claim, including the supplement your adjuster missed.

special.title: Free estimate while you wait
special.body: Drive in before 3pm on a weekday and you leave with a written estimate and photos, not a callback.

cards.title: We bill your insurer directly
cards.body: You pay the deductible, we invoice the carrier. No cheque to chase and no paperwork to forward.

cards.title: While it's here
cards.body: Enterprise pickup from our lot, a loaner for jobs over three days, and a text with photos at every stage.

owner.name: Dana Okonkwo
owner.title: Owner, I-CAR Platinum
owner.note: My father opened this shop in 1998 and I did my apprenticeship in the paint booth out back. What I tell people now is what he told them: your insurer can recommend a shop, but they cannot make you use one. If the estimate you were handed misses something, bring it here and I will write up what it actually takes, line by line, and argue it with the adjuster myself.

reasons.title: You choose the shop, not the carrier
reasons.body: Oregon law is on your side on this. We will say it plainly and put it in writing if you need it.

reasons.title: Every stage, photographed
reasons.body: Tear-down, frame readings, primer, colour, reassembly. The file follows the car and it is yours.

reasons.title: Lifetime on our workmanship
reasons.body: For as long as you own the car. If the paint lifts in four years, it comes back and we redo it.

reviews.name: Tomas L.
reviews.text: Insurer pushed me hard toward their own shop. Northline took it, found $2,400 of structural work the first estimate missed, and got the supplement approved. Car measures straight.

reviews.name: Rhea B.
reviews.text: Hail wrote off half the panels. They handled the claim, the rental, and had it back in nine days. The colour match on a ten-year-old car is genuinely invisible.

reviews.name: Marcus D.
reviews.text: Work van, so every day down costs me money. They sourced the door in a day and got me back on the road Thursday. Told me the second dent could wait rather than selling me on it.

copy.headline: Collision and paint work that measures straight, and a claim we argue for you
copy.tagline: I-CAR Gold Class body shop on Columbia Boulevard. We bill your insurer direct, photograph every stage, and warranty the workmanship for as long as you own the car.
copy.heroFinePrint: Walk-in estimates until 3pm weekdays · Free tow inside 20 miles on an insurance job
copy.servicesLede: Collision work is quoted off a tear-down, not a glance. These are honest starting numbers for the jobs we can price before we look.
copy.ownerHeading: How a claim actually goes here
copy.bookingLede: Four things and we'll call you back, usually the same morning.
copy.bookingEscape: If the car isn't drivable, don't fill this out — call
copy.bookingEscapeTail: and we'll get a flatbed to you.

seo.description: I-CAR Gold Class collision repair and paint in Portland, OR. Direct insurance billing, ADAS recalibration, lifetime workmanship warranty. Call (503) 555-0182.

insurance.heading: We work with every major carrier
insurance.lede: You are not required to use the shop your insurer names. Bring us the claim number and we take it from there.

steps.title: Call us with the claim number
steps.body: Or drive in. We photograph the damage and open a file the same day.

steps.title: We write the real estimate
steps.body: Off a tear-down, not a walk-around. Supplements go to the adjuster with photos attached.

steps.title: You pay the deductible, we bill the rest
steps.body: Direct to the carrier. You do not front the repair and wait for a cheque.

insurance.note: Not an insurance company and not acting as your agent. We write repair estimates and negotiate them on the repair's merits.
